origine_fr: Il y a plus de 3 000 ans, 豕 dessinait un cochon dressé à la verticale : ventre rond, pattes courtes, queue pendante. C'est le cochon. Sous le toit 宀, il forme 家, la maison, mais on discute encore de pourquoi.
origine_en: Over 3,000 years ago, 豕 was drawn as a pig standing on end: round belly, short legs, hanging tail. It is the pig. Under the roof 宀 it forms 家, home, though people still argue about why.
